Where the licence files in this folder came from. This note is not a licence and does not change the files beside it.

Ubuntu-Light-UFL.txt
  The licence body is fonts/UFL.txt from the crate epaint_default_fonts 0.36.2, copied unchanged.
  The two lines above that body are name-table entries in fonts/Ubuntu-Light.ttf from the same crate:
  name ID 0, "Copyright 2011 Canonical Ltd. Licensed under the Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0";
  name ID 7, "Ubuntu and Canonical are registered trademarks of Canonical Ltd."
  SwiftPDF embeds that font through egui. The font file itself is not a separate file in this zip.

Hack-Regular-LICENSE.txt
  fonts/Hack-Regular.txt from epaint_default_fonts 0.36.2, copied unchanged.
  It is the MIT notice for Hack and the Bitstream Vera licence for Bitstream Vera Sans Mono.
  SwiftPDF embeds Hack through egui.

OFL-NotoEmoji.txt
  The licence body is fonts/OFL.txt from epaint_default_fonts 0.36.2, copied unchanged.
  The copyright line above it is name ID 0 of fonts/NotoEmoji-Regular.ttf from the same crate:
  "Copyright 2013 Google Inc. All Rights Reserved."
  SwiftPDF embeds that font through egui.

LICENSE-FOXIT.txt
  vendor/hayro-interpret/assets/LICENSE_FOXIT in this repository, copied unchanged.
  It covers the Foxit standard-14 fonts bundled by hayro-interpret.

LICENSE-CMAP.txt
  assets/LICENSE.txt from the crate hayro-cmap 0.1.0, copied unchanged.
  It is the BSD licence for the Adobe CMap resources bundled by that crate.
  NOTICE in this zip names the same copyright line.
